Name: BuyLocal
Project Overview: BuyLocal is a Hyperlocal delivery solution to help customers buy products from nearby stores and supermarkets easily and support the local economy.

Name: CashPool
Project Overview: Money pooling app that lets users create groups and pool money towards shared goals. The app provides a platform with easy and transparent bookkeeping for the ideal money pooling experience.

Name: ShoppersMap
Project Overview: Shopper’s Map is an engaging new way for users to shop at their supermarket. The user can form a shared shopping list and the app allows for a better supermarket navigation experience.
